question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "huge​."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence describes a situation where almost every civilisation has a legend about a massive flood.
 
• "Huge" means very big. (बहुत बड़ा, विशाल)
 
 
• Example:* The costs involved in building a spacecraft are **huge**__.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2."
 
• Correct passage:

A flood occurs when water overflows its natural __barriers__ and lands on typically dry ground. Floods have always been an __unavoidable__ component of life on the planet. A legend about a __**huge**__ flood exists in almost every civilisation. Many people have ______ (4) ______ to live near bodies of water in order to have access to transportation routes, fishing, and water for drinking, farming, and industry. The majority of the world's major cities are ______ (5) ______ on or near oceans, lakes, or rivers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ 

 
• Looking at other options:

 
 
• **Limit: **the greatest or smallest amount of something that is allowed or possible. (किसी वस्‍तु की अधिकतम या न्‍यूनतम मात्रा जो संभव या मान्‍य हो; सीमा; हद)
 
• **Induced: **caused by the stated person or activity. (बताए गए व्यक्ति या गतिविधि के कारण)
 
• **Controlled: **involving careful, intentional actions that limit risk or danger. (जोखिम या खतरे को सीमित करने वाली सावधानीपूर्वक, जानबूझकर की जाने वाली कार्रवाइयां शामिल हैं)
